paths._ar_aging_note: No customer-level AR aging export exists for this borrower (2026-06 Close Notes: 'No customer-level aging was delivered in this control case; do not infer aging buckets.'). Only Inventory_Aging files are delivered monthly. ap-ar-aging is therefore excluded from modules below.

module_inputs._note: ap-ar-aging and revenue-quality omitted: no AR/AP aging exports exist for this borrower, and revenue is equipment-shipment-driven rather than recurring/subscription (IC memo explicitly excludes unsupported ARR framing).

model_lines._gap_note: Borrower's management accounts stop at Reported EBITDA — no net income, interest expense, tax, or D&A line is broken out on the Income Statement or Balance Sheet. three-statement-analysis will flag net_income/interest/coverage metrics as unresolved rather than guess a row.

analysis_notes: Reporting basis note (2026-06 Close Notes): first-and-final package, no restatement or basis change.

2026 Q2 Portfolio Management folder contains a Lender_Query_Unsupported_Addback and Borrower_Correction_Notice plus both an ORIGINAL and CORRECTED Covenant_Calculation for Q2 2026 — covenant-setup and the covenant-compliance module should use the CORRECTED version and note the correction history.
Budget (Monthly Operating Plan) is only built down to Budget EBITDA — it does not budget interest, taxes, D&A or net income, consistent with the model's own gap noted in model_lines.

analysis_lines._omitted_note: total_current_assets and total_current_liabilities omitted — this borrower's Balance Sheet has no such subtotal rows (only CURRENT ASSETS / NON-CURRENT ASSETS section headers with no current subtotal). current_ratio/working_capital ratios will be suppressed with a disclosed reason rather than mismapped.
